assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
This service is medically necessary to evaluate intermittent symptoms consistent with the documented diagnoses I25.10 and I34.0.
As noted in the payer letter, proper authorization is required for this specific diagnostic procedure, and appropriate precertification has now been secured to support coverage eligibility.
